plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's dreams. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their sense of identity, confidence, and direction sit right on top of your imagination, hope, and idealism. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: And yet Neptune's gifts are rarely uncomplicated. The same vision that inspires can also distort. The Neptune person may be relating to a dream, a longing, or an ideal as much as they are relating to the actual person in front of them. The Sun person may find themselves stepping into that role, consciously or not, because it feels good to be adored for what someone believes you could be. But no one can live inside a projection forever. Eventually the human being beneath the image asks to be seen. When reality arrives, it can feel like a loss, not because the connection was false, but because the fantasy was so powerful.
advice: The invitation here is to let wonder and truth exist together, without asking either one to disappear. This aspect works best when both people make room for reality from the beginning. Being admired is not the same as being truly seen.
summaryShort: Their sense of identity, confidence, and direction sit right on top of your imagination, hope, and idealism.
